Clerk.description: A member of the front desk team: receptionist, concierge, night porter or manager. A first name alone is not an identity.

Guest.description: A person staying at, booking or paying for a room at the hotel.

DeskCover.description: How two clerks stand on the rota: one relieves the other at handover, or is the other's duty manager.

GuestCare.description: Which clerk personally looks after a guest during a stay: the concierge, or a dedicated butler.

Stay.description: A guest's stay in one room. checked_in_by handled arrival, upgraded_by gave an upgrade, billed_to pays; status is reserved, checked_in, checked_out or no_show.

Complaint.description: A guest's complaint about one issue. resolved stays empty until a resolution is recorded.

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Clerk)-[:relief]->(n1:Clerk) WHERE n0.badge = 'Saoirse Quinlan' RETURN n1.badge AS badge

questions.speaker: paulo
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Clerk)-[:duty_manager]->(n1:Clerk) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.badge AS badge

questions.speaker: saoirse
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Clerk)-[:team]->(n1:Clerk) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.badge AS badge

questions.speaker: nnamdi
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Clerk)-[:guests]->(n1:Guest) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.guest_name AS guest_name
MATCH (n0:Guest)-[:concierge]->(n1:Clerk) WHERE n0.guest_name = 'Rafael Ibarguen' RETURN n1.badge AS badge

questions.q: Who will be Oluwaseun Adebayo's butler?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Guest)-[:butler]->(n1:Clerk) WHERE n0.guest_name = 'Oluwaseun Adebayo' RETURN n1.badge AS badge

questions.q: How many nights is the Harbour Suite booked for?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Stay) WHERE n0.room = 'the Harbour Suite' RETURN n0.nights AS nights

questions.q: Which rooms did Tomasz Wierzbicki check in?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Clerk)<-[:checked_in_by]-(n1:Stay) WHERE n0.badge = 'Tomasz Wierzbicki' RETURN n1.room AS room

questions.q: Which rooms are billed to me?
questions.speaker: ingrid
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Guest)<-[:billed_to]-(n1:Stay) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.room AS room

questions.q: Is there a record of breakfast for room 208?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Stay) WHERE n0.room = 'room 208' RETURN coalesce(n0.breakfast, false) AS breakfast

questions.q: Did Rafael Ibarguen's stay include breakfast?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Guest)<-[:guest]-(n1:Stay) WHERE n0.guest_name = 'Rafael Ibarguen' RETURN n1.breakfast AS breakfast

questions.q: Has Mei-Lin Tsao's complaint been resolved?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Guest)<-[:guest]-(n1:Complaint) WHERE n0.guest_name = 'Mei-Lin Tsao' RETURN n1.resolved AS resolved

questions.q: What issue and refund does each complaint record?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Complaint) RETURN n0.issue AS issue, n0.refund_pounds AS refund_pounds

questions.q: What is Ingrid Halvorsen's loyalty number?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Guest) WHERE n0.guest_name = 'Ingrid Halvorsen' RETURN n0.loyalty_no AS loyalty_no

questions.q: Who handled the complaint about the shower?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Complaint)-[:handled_by]->(n1:Clerk) WHERE n0.issue CONTAINS 'shower' RETURN n1.badge AS badge
